narrative: The technology sector is abuzz with major developments across AI, space, and corporate legal battles. Apple has filed a blockbuster lawsuit against OpenAI for alleged trade secret theft, coinciding with rising privacy concerns around AI tools like Grok. Concurrently, fusion energy marked a significant public market debut with General Fusion, and SpaceX secured clearance for its next Starship flight, while regulatory bodies in the EU push for stricter social media limits for minors.

highlights.title: Investors send General Fusion soaring in debut as first publicly traded fusion company
highlights.whyItMatters: This marks a pivotal moment for the fusion energy sector, introducing the first publicly traded company focused on developing this potentially transformative clean energy source.

highlights.title: Apple sues OpenAI over alleged trade secret theft
highlights.whyItMatters: This high-profile lawsuit between two tech giants highlights escalating competition and legal battles over intellectual property in the rapidly evolving artificial intelligence industry.

highlights.title: The 6 wildest claims in Apple’s lawsuit against OpenAI
highlights.whyItMatters: This further details significant allegations of espionage and intellectual property theft by Apple against OpenAI, potentially revealing aggressive tactics in the AI arms race.

highlights.title: Grok uploaded my user directory to xAI's servers
highlights.whyItMatters: This report raises serious concerns about data privacy and security with AI tools, prompting scrutiny over how AI applications handle sensitive user information.

highlights.title: 12 states sue to block Paramount’s $110B Warner Bros. deal
highlights.whyItMatters: This significant antitrust action against a massive media merger underscores growing regulatory concern over market consolidation and its potential impact on consumers and competition.

highlights.title: SpaceX cleared to fly Starship again after booster failure in May
highlights.whyItMatters: The clearance for another Starship flight is crucial for SpaceX's ambitious plans for reusable rocketry and interplanetary travel, despite its 'fly, fail, fix' development approach.

highlights.title: Social media limits are coming for teens across Europe
highlights.whyItMatters: New European regulations signal a major shift in how social media platforms will operate, imposing stricter age verification and content restrictions to protect young users.
